scope: fresh synthetic development regression, NOT final evaluation

smoke_policy.execution: real GoalExecutionAgent and bounded Python sandbox
smoke_policy.retrieval: fresh in-memory synthetic sources; not production Chroma retrieval
smoke_policy.synthesis: controlled refusal to exercise grounded fallback

limitations: Synthetic development results do not estimate unseen engineering QA accuracy.
Semantic support depends on a fallible local model; exact spans and engineering checks constrain but do not prove entailment.
Evidence selection is bounded to 24 retrieved records, eight spans per record and at most 32 spans/16000 source characters per semantic check.
A corrected false premise retains CONTRADICTED support and is not labeled unconditionally achieved.
Extractive answers retain the source language inside quotations.
Compound units support bounded literal algebra, not automatic unit-system conversion.
